items.stem: An IS auditor begins an engagement by deciding which controls to test. What should drive that decision first?

options.text: A risk assessment of the area under audit
options.rationale: Correct: a risk-based IS audit plans testing according to assessed risk.

options.text: The order controls appear in the system manual
options.rationale: Manual order does not reflect risk.

options.text: Whichever controls are easiest to test
options.rationale: Convenience is not a basis for a risk-based audit.

options.rationale: This reverses and misstates the roles.
